source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit, recorded in rytm2_mods ctrl-all/README.md at afd461d and the C3A4 unit test; and the SXH4 bench runs on the same unit (2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25); and the solo bench run of CAH4 on the same unit (2026-10-25)
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74: in R8K4 (2026-10-19) ctrl-all 1.2's tests 1 to 4 pass: TRK + FRQ moves FRQ on another track by the same amount; on the SYNTH page with BD HARD on track 1 and SD HARD on track 2 every knob pairs by its place on the screen, and a machine with an empty knob stays put; TRK + TYP sets every track's type; with the FX track selected or a trig key held only the selected track changes. In C3A4 (core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven rytm2_mods v1.2 ports, 2026-10-20) each mod's own test passed, including this one's. On SXH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 with the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions, 2026-10-24) TRK + FRQ moved several tracks together and the FX track changed alone, and a four-minute play showed no freeze or dropout. Alone on CAH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 and this module only, 2026-10-25) TRK + FRQ moved several tracks together and the FX track changed alone.
scope: ctrl-all 1.2 beside other rytm2_mods ports. SXH4 ran it with the released core-ar2 0.3 and the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions. CAH4 ran it alone with the released core-ar2 0.3.

builds.label: CAH4
builds.content: The released core-ar2 0.3 and this module's rytm2_mods v1.2 release object as the only module, plus the remote-control test layer (analoghealth 1.2, no site shared with core or the module). Driven over USB by a scripted bench in a ~T test project; outputs recorded over USB audio; stock 1.74 restored after the run.
results: Alone: TRK + FRQ moved BD, SD and CH together; the FX track changed alone (screens).
No freeze or dropout on any output.

builds.label: SXH4
builds.content: The released core-ar2 0.3 and rytm2_mods v1.2's release objects for the six Modwerk 1.74 submissions, plus a remote-control test layer (three sites, none shared with core or the modules). Without the test layer the same inputs give SX74 (2a352718de044cdba51a2b8a3a064ef126d79ab54f24ac7a7662f6c686e64371). Driven over USB by a scripted bench in a ~T test project; outputs recorded over USB audio; stock 1.74 restored after each run.
results: SXH4: TRK + FRQ moved BD, SD and CH together; the FX track changed alone (screens).

Four minutes of play with samples, delay and reverb sends and knob turns: no freeze, gap or level dip on any output; clicks on the main mix also appear on the same core and test layer without the modules.

builds.label: C3A4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.3 as built before elekloader #153, and rytm2_mods v1.2's eleven OS 1.74 release objects. Relinking those files on stock 1.74 gives this main OS byte for byte.
results: Each mod's own test passed, including Ctrl All's.

builds.label: R8K4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.1 ported to 1.74 with filter-hz, ctrl-all 1.2 (rytm2_mods 7508487), env-reset-amp, slice-loop, main-rms, comp-preview and kit-ab.
results: Test 1: TRK + FRQ on the FILTER page moves another track's FRQ by the same amount.
Test 2: SYNTH page, BD HARD (track 1) and SD HARD (track 2): every knob pairs by its place on the screen; a machine with an empty knob stays put.
Test 3: TRK + TYP: every track takes the type the selected track reaches.
Test 4: with the FX track selected, or a trig key held, only the selected track changes.

individualTestResults: FILTER FRQ follows on another track
SYNTH knobs pair by screen position across BD HARD and SD HARD
FILTER TYP set on every track
FX track and held trig key stay single-track
SXH4: FRQ follows across tracks; FX track alone
SXH4: four-minute play, no freeze or dropout
Alone (CAH4): FRQ follows across tracks; FX track alone

contextNote: Main OS hashes are the builds', not read back from the device. SXH4 links the released core-ar2 0.3 (6b97dfb3…, with #153) that Modwerk links; C3A4's core was built before #153.
